objectives: The topics in this course will include external and internal environment, staffing, compensation system, training, and some special topics. Theories and practices are equally emphasized in this class. All students are expected to read the assignments before coming to the classroom and complete the project papers at the end of the semester.  Homework and other assignment will be given by instructors during the class.
content:
1.	人力資源管理課程簡介
2.	組織與管理量化研究
3.	現代哲學與人力資源管理
4.	人才管理
5.	領導與管理發展
6.	領導與組織變革
7.	組織與人力資源管理
8.	策略性人力資源管理
9.	績效與目標管理
10.	激勵與薪酬管理
11.	組織行為與人力資源管理
12.	國際人力資源管理
13.	協商
14.	期末報告
books: Noe, R.A., Hollenbeck, J.R., & Gerhart, B., Wright, P. Human Resource Management: Gaining a competitive advantage. Boston, MA: McGraw-Hill Irwin.
